paragraphs.text: The Sword of Asha , called the Shattered Sword after its fracturing, is an ancient relic, the weapon used by the angel Asha in her final battle against Malfegor . A Sigil of Asha was built into the sword's crossguard.
During Asha's battle with Malfegor, the sword was broken into twelve pieces, which were buried under the Twelve Trees of Valeron .
Thanks to the Order of the Skyward Eye 's manipulation of the Prayer of Asha , the Sword of Asha was widely regarded as little more than a myth at the time of the Conflux .
Ultimately, the rhox Mubin realized the sword was real, dug up the pieces, and had it reforged. It was then given to Rafiq who managed to kill Malfegor with the weapon.
